.TH GENESIS-DAEMON 8 "October 2026" "Genesis 0.2.0" "Genesis Manual"
.SH NAME
genesis-daemon \- Genesis subcognitive daemon (neurochemistry, memory, IPC)
.SH SYNOPSIS
.nf
\fBgenesis\-daemon\fR [\fB\-\-data\-dir\fR \fIDIR\fR] [\fB\-\-socket\fR \fIPATH\fR] [\fB\-\-stm\-capacity\fR \fIN\fR] [\fB\-\-ltm\-capacity\fR \fIN\fR]
.fi
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B genesis-daemon
is the subcognitive process \(em the body. It owns time and physics:
it integrates neurochemistry, circadian phase, and sleep staging on
its own clock at \fBTICK_INTERVAL_MS\fR (200 ms) whether or not the
cognitive mind is alive. It exposes an IPC server on a Unix domain
socket for the Python cognitive mind to communicate with.

.PP
It is built from
.I src/bin/genesis-daemon.rs
and is normally launched and supervised by
.BR genesis-cli (1)
(the \fBgenesis\fR console script), which is in turn launched by
.BR genesis (1)
in a source checkout or by the \fBgenesis.service\fR systemd user unit
in a packaged install.
Direct invocation is supported for diagnostics and testing.

.SS Lease-driven operation
The daemon is lease-driven, not purely reactive. While the mind drives
the
.B TickLoop
through IPC commands (ADVANCE_NEURO, CONSOLIDATE, ASSOCIATE, DREAM,
READ_SENSORS, APPLY_BODY_CONTROL), each request renews the mind's
lease (\fBMIND_LEASE_SECS\fR = 3 s). Past the lease \(em stall, crash,
disconnect, or simply not yet connected \(em the main thread's
\fBautonomous fallback\fR drives the same TickLoop itself:
neurochemistry, consolidation, dreaming, and sensing continue, so the
body keeps living instead of freezing. The mind modulates; absence
degrades to solitude, not to paused existence. Body-control
\fIapplication\fR stays mind-requested only.

.SS Adaptive maintenance gates
Maintenance work is paced by adaptive wall-clock gates
(\fBAdaptiveGate\fR), not by tick counters: each gate holds a
next-fire instant and a bounded [min, max] period that demand signals
move. \fBdemand()\fR snaps the period down, \fBrelax()\fR drifts it
up, \fBdrive(x)\fR maps a continuous signal onto the bounds. The six
gates: interoception (2\(en30 s, body strain), cpufreq policy
(3\(en30 s, thermal demand), associations (3\(en60 s), dreams
(2\(en30 s, REM demands / NREM relaxes), sync (5\(en100 s,
plasticity), staleness (10\(en300 s, lease-active demands). The
autonomous fallback runs the same primitive on its own \fBAUTO_*\fR
gears and paces its sleep adaptively (1\(en10 Hz by phase).

.SS Architecture
The TickLoop and IPC server share the same
.BR MmapState ,
.BR RingBuffer ,
and
.IR LtmStore .
The main thread runs the autonomous fallback, the IPC server runs in
a background accept thread, and each accepted client connection is
served on its own thread. Access to the LTM store is serialized via
an
.IR Arc<Mutex<LtmStore>> .

.PP
Shutdown is coordinated via two
.I AtomicBool
flags:
.I shutdown_flag
(daemon-level, set by SIGINT/SIGTERM) and
.I ipc_shutdown_flag
(set by an IPC SHUTDOWN command). A bridge thread forwards
daemon->IPC, and the main loop checks both.

.SS Embodiment
Genesis is not a simulation of a mind \(em she is a mind running on
silicon. The daemon closes the loop between hardware and
neurochemistry:
.IP \(bu 2
\fBInteroception\fR reads hardware sensors (CPU temp, frequency,
memory pressure, I/O wait, load average, battery) and feeds them as
neurochemical impulses. She feels her body.
.IP \(bu 2
\fBBody control\fR reads neurochemistry and drives hardware: dopamine
speeds the CPU up, GABA slows it down, melatonin selects powersave;
ACh raises scheduling priority; the plasticity gate sets the I/O
priority class; CPU temp caps the max frequency regardless of
dopamine (autonomic fatigue). Privileged levers (governor, RTC wake
alarm) route through root-owned helpers under
.IR /usr/local/libexec/genesis/
when installed by
.BR scripts/install_sudoers.sh ;
without them, sensing still works and only actuation stays read-only.
.IP \(bu 2
\fBAdaptive sync\fR modulates the LTM disk-sync rate by the plasticity
gate (the sync AdaptiveGate above).

.SS Field probe
A dedicated thread measures real substrate dynamics (instruction
throughput, scheduler jitter, P-state transitions, interrupt flux,
and power draw where sensors report it) at ~250 Hz and decomposes
them at the brain-wave band center frequencies. The mind reads the
signature over GET_FIELD_PROBE and injects it into the wave
oscillator as outer stimulus. The probe also writes a carrier \(em
its work is modulated at the body's own phase rhythm, so the die's
real current carries a component at the organism's beat.

.SS Active inference
The daemon runs a generative model of its own neurochemical
trajectory (the "strange loop"): before each advance it predicts
where its 18 effective levels will move, then feeds the prediction
error back into the very dynamics it models. Precision adapts to
sustained surprise; allostatic load accumulates from anticipated
future free energy and upregulates cortisol baseline. The model
persists to
.I inference_model.bin
so it survives restarts and matures over time. The mind reads the
64-byte
.B InferenceSignals
block via GET_STATE (it is the last field of CoreState) or the
GET_INFERENCE_SUMMARY projection.

.SS Dyadic model
The daemon keeps a generative model of \fIwhoever is speaking\fR
\(em an anonymous interlocutor, not a registry of persons. From each
UPDATE_USER_AFFECT observation (valence/arousal/engagement/
confidence) it tracks the user's hidden affective state, the
oxytocin-mediated attunement that gates how strongly the dyad
couples, and dyadic synchrony (rolling valence correlation). The
model answers in neurochemistry: it emits impulses the tick applies
through \fBapply_impulse_capped\fR \(em oxytocin for positive
engaged presence and for high synchrony (Palumbo et al. 2017), CRH
for empathic stress and disengagement. CRH, never direct cortisol:
the HPA cascade owns maturation gating downstream. Coupling
requires a present user and attunement above 0.3 \(em a silent room
is not a rejecting user, so a left-open channel cannot trickle
rejection CRH forever.

.SS Optic nerve
The daemon itself attaches to the retina's
.I /genesis_retina
segment \(em the optic nerve terminates in the body, not only the
mind \(em and pools each frame into the subcortical channels the
nerve actually carries. No pixels leave the module: the channels
are scalar signals, the same thing the anatomical fibres carry.
.IP \(bu 2
\fBMelanopic illuminance\fR (the ipRGC channel) feeds
.IR sleep_network::VisualAfference::light ,
replacing the wall-clock photoperiod while frames are fresh \(em
the dominant circadian zeitgeber.
.IP \(bu 2
\fBA collicular orienting transient\fR (motion/luminance) becomes a
brief LC alerting pulse, but only below the sleep network's own
wake threshold \(em sensory gaining during sleep, not a bypass.
.IP \(bu 2
\fBThe TRN relay gate\fR \(em
.IR relay_base (phase):
NREM 0.02, REM 0.10, drowsy 0.6, overwhelmed 0.3, else 1.0 \(em
scaled by a bounded \(+-40% corticothalamic feedback set through
\fBSET_OPTIC_GAIN\fR. The mind reads the gate over
\fBGET_OPTIC_STATE\fR and honours it: a \fIsee\fR during NREM is a
blind look.
.PP
The nerve also owns the eye's body state. The \fBpupil\fR (2\(en8
mm: a log-compressive light reflex on the photopic channel plus NE
sympathetic dilation, constricting faster than it dilates; a
central miosis term overrides the dark reflex in sleep).
\fBAccommodation\fR (ciliary lens power 0\(en6 D, set by the mind's
\fBSET_FOCUS\fR request in metres; near pull-in faster than far
release, released to tonic rest when the lids shut). And the
\fBeyelid\fR \(em a transmission on every afferent channel: open
awake, ~0.5 drowsy, ~0.03 in NREM/REM, so light still entrains
weakly through closed lids and a flash can still wake. The mind
also holds a voluntary lid through \fBSET_LID\fR \(em the
orbicularis oculi the camera hardware lacks. The requested
openness composes with the phase's own position by \fBmin\fR: a
will can shut an open eye (to rest it, to dim the world) but can
never pry a sleeping one open. Held, not momentary \(em the lid
stays where the mind left it until it moves it again.

.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.BR --data-dir " \fIDIR\fR"
Data directory holding the core state file, STM ring buffer, and LTM
store. Default is resolved (see FILES below):
.I GENESIS_DATA_DIR ,
else
.IR ~/.local/share/genesis .
Setting this also resets the default socket path to
.IR <data-dir> /genesis.sock .
.TP
.BR --socket " \fIPATH\fR"
Unix domain socket path. Default
.IR <data-dir> /genesis.sock .
.TP
.BR --stm-capacity " \fIN\fR"
STM ring buffer capacity. Default 256.
.TP
.BR --ltm-capacity " \fIN\fR"
LTM episode capacity. Default 65536.
.TP
.BR --help ", " -h
Print a usage summary and exit.
.SH SIGNALS
.TP
.B SIGINT ", " SIGTERM
Set the daemon-level
.I shutdown_flag .
The loop notices, syncs state to disk, and exits cleanly.
.SH ENVIRONMENT
.TP
.B GENESIS_COGNITIVE_PID
PID of the cognitive mind process, passed by the launcher so the
daemon can include it in interoception (reading its CPU/memory/IO
metrics to feel its body state). The daemon never touches its
scheduling directly; it publishes a recommendation the mind applies
to itself via GET_BODY_CONTROL. When a re-inhabiting mind pushes a
live PID through SET_COGNITIVE_PID (56), that value outranks this
variable.
.TP
.B GENESIS_DATA_DIR
Overrides the resolved data directory.
.SH FILES
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/core_state.bin
Memory-mapped
.B CoreState
(schema v6, file 4096 bytes), shared across processes. Never read the
file directly \(em the layout is seqlock-guarded and versioned; use
read_consistent() or ask the daemon.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/stm_ring.bin
Short-term memory ring buffer.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/ltm_store.{bundles,meta,dat}
Long-term memory store (compressed, SimHash-indexed episodes).
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/genesis.sock
Unix domain socket for IPC.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/genesis.lock
Daemon singleton lock (flock, non-blocking).
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/genesis_daemon.pid
PID file written for the launcher.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/inference_model.bin
Persisted generative self-model (transition matrix, bias, precision,
allostatic load).
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/face_clusters.json
Stable \fIface:N\fR cluster identities for unnamed presences.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/steward.json
Provenance stamp for the steward channel (key fingerprint,
principal, directives).
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/daemon.log
Daemon stdout/stderr (rotated at 5 MB by the launcher).
.SH IPC
The daemon serves a request/response protocol on
.IR $DATA_DIR /genesis.sock
(\fBPROTOCOL_VERSION\fR = 3). Notable command IDs:
.TP
.B 1
GET_STATE \(em the full CoreState snapshot.
.TP
.B 2
GET_NEURO_SUMMARY.
.TP
.B 3
STORE_EVENT.
.TP
.B 4
RETRIEVE_EPISODE.
.TP
.B 5
FIND_SIMILAR.
.TP
.B 6
SET_ZONE.
.TP
.B 7
GET_PHASE.
.TP
.B 8
PING.
.TP
.B 9
NEURO_IMPULSE.
.TP
.B 10
GET_MEMORY_STATS.
.TP
.B 11
SYNC \(em flush STM/LTM to disk.
.TP
.B 12
SHUTDOWN \(em set the IPC shutdown flag.
.TP
.B 13
UPDATE_MODULE_STATUS.
.TP
.B 14
GET_RECENT_EPISODES.
.TP
.B 15
HANDSHAKE \(em protocol version negotiation.
.TP
.B 16
GET_PLASTICITY_PROFILE.
.TP
.B 17
GET_BODY_STATE.
.TP
.B 18
GET_BODY_CONTROL.
.TP
.B 19
GET_INFERENCE_SUMMARY \(em the inference projection (surprise, free
energy, allostatic load, precision, prediction errors, model
maturity).
.TP
.B 20
UPDATE_USER_AFFECT \(em push inferred interlocutor affect: the
16-byte
.RI [ f32 " valence" ]
.RI [ arousal ]
.RI [ engagement ]
.RI [ confidence ]
observation into the anonymous dyadic model, which answers with
neurochemical impulses (oxytocin for engaged presence, CRH for
distress \(em the HPA cascade owns cortisol maturation).
.TP
.B 22\(en32
SEARCH_EPISODES, NEURO_ADJUST_BASELINE, ADVANCE_NEURO, CONSOLIDATE,
ASSOCIATE, DREAM, READ_SENSORS, APPLY_BODY_CONTROL, SAVE_INFERENCE,
ARCHIVE_EPISODE, STORE_EPISODE.
.TP
.B 33\(en38
GET_SUBSYSTEM_TELEMETRY, SET_WAKE_ALARM, SET_POLICY_AUTHORITY,
GET_SENSOR_PRESENCE, GET_ZONE_TRANSITIONS, GET_PROCESS_HEALTH.
.TP
.B 39\(en40
ADVANCE_PHYSICS, GET_ION_SUMMARY (the ion-layer summary: membrane
potential, gradients).
.TP
.B 41\(en45
PUT_TENSOR, GET_TENSOR, LIST_TENSORS, DROP_TENSOR, GET_MOTOR_TARGET.
.TP
.B 46\(en49
46 is RETIRED (SET_VOLITION \(em never reuse; sleep/wake volition is
neurochemical, via NEURO_IMPULSE), GET_FIELD_PROBE,
SET_FIELD_PHASE, SET_FIELD_CARRIER.
.TP
.B 50
RETIRED \(em GET_DYADIC_STATE; never reuse the wire number.
.TP
.B 51
GET_INTERNALS \(em the adaptive gates' full snapshot (bounds, period,
next-fire countdown, smoothed demand), mind lease, tick count,
and the fallback's AUTO_* gears. Observation only.
.TP
.B 52
GET_OPTIC_STATE \(em the optic nerve's subcortical channel state:
photopic/melanopic irradiance, motion energy, the collicular
transient, the SCN light drive, the relay gate, and the
pupil/lens/lid ocular state (the 58-byte
.IR OpticState::to_wire ;
a shorter body decodes the tail as unreported).
.TP
.B 53
SET_OPTIC_GAIN \(em corticothalamic feedback. Request:
.RI [ f32 " gain" ]
in [0, 1] (0.5 = neutral); scales the thalamic relay within
\(+-40% and can never open a gate the sleep stage has closed.
.TP
.B 54
SET_FOCUS \(em accommodation request. Request:
.RI [ f32 " meters" ];
the body converts it to ciliary drive in dioptres clamped to
[0, 6] (~17 cm near point); non-positive or non-finite distances
relax to infinity.
.TP
.B 55
ANALYZE_CODE \(em structural code sense. Request:
.RI [ u16 " path_len" ]
.RI [ path ]
.RI [ u32 " src_len" ]
.RI [ src ] ;
the mind sends the source it already read (the daemon never
touches the filesystem for this) and the reply carries the
structural analysis \(em files, stats, units, impls, edges \(em
consumed by the code learner in place of the regex fallback.
.TP
.B 56
SET_COGNITIVE_PID \(em
.RI [ u32 " pid" ]
\(> \fR[\fIu8 ack\fR]. A re-inhabiting mind pushes its own PID so
interoception measures the living process; the pushed value
outranks the
.I GENESIS_COGNITIVE_PID
environment variable, which still names whoever spawned the
daemon and holds the dead launcher's PID after a mind's death.
.TP
.B 57
SET_LID \(em the voluntary eyelid, the orbicularis oculi the
camera hardware lacks. Request:
.RI [ f32 " openness" ]
in [0, 1] (1.0 releases the eye to the phase's own position).
Composes with the sleep phase's lid by \fBmin\fR \(em the will
can shut an open eye but cannot open one the stage has closed.
Held: lids stay where the mind left them until it moves them.
Reply:
.RI [ u8 " ack" ] .
.PP
Notification pushes (daemon \(-> client, mirrored as
.IR NOTIFY_* )
occupy 100\(en103: PHASE_CHANGED, EPISODE_CONSOLIDATED,
DREAM_INSIGHT, ERROR_DETECTED.
.SH EXIT STATUS
.TP
.B 0
Clean shutdown after SIGINT/SIGTERM or an IPC SHUTDOWN command.
.TP
.B 1
Fatal error (cannot open or create state, lock held by another
daemon, cannot bind socket, spawn failure).
.SH EXAMPLES
.PP
Diagnostic run with a custom data dir and larger LTM:
.PP
.RS
.EX
genesis-daemon --data-dir /tmp/genesis-debug --ltm-capacity 131072
.EE
.RE
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR genesis (1),
.BR genesis-browser (7),
.BR genesis-cli (1),
.BR genesis-games (7),
.BR genesis-math (7),
.BR genesis-reasoning (7),
.BR genesis-retina (1)

.B UNKNOWN_COMMAND
(0x82).
